parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: ID of the cluster to remove. (templated)

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: ID of the folder in which cluster should be created.

parameters.name: cluster_name
parameters.description: Cluster name. Must be unique inside the folder.

parameters.name: cluster_description
parameters.description: Cluster description.

parameters.name: cluster_image_version
parameters.description: Cluster image version. Use default.

parameters.name: ssh_public_keys
parameters.description: List of SSH public keys that will be deployed to created compute instances.

parameters.name: subnet_id
parameters.description: ID of the subnetwork. All Data Proc cluster nodes will use one subnetwork.

parameters.name: services
parameters.description: List of services that will be installed to the cluster. Possible options: HDFS, YARN, MAPREDUCE, HIVE, TEZ, ZOOKEEPER, HBASE, SQOOP, FLUME, SPARK, SPARK, ZEPPELIN, OOZIE

parameters.name: s3_bucket
parameters.description: Yandex.Cloud S3 bucket to store cluster logs. Jobs will not work if the bucket is not specified.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Availability zone to create cluster in. Currently there are ru-central1-a, ru-central1-b and ru-central1-c.

parameters.name: service_account_id
parameters.description: Service account id for the cluster. Service account can be created inside the folder.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Environment for the cluster. Possible options: PRODUCTION, PRESTABLE.

parameters.name: masternode_resource_preset
parameters.description: Resources preset (CPU+RAM configuration) for the primary node of the cluster.

parameters.name: masternode_disk_size
parameters.description: Masternode storage size in GiB.

parameters.name: masternode_disk_type
parameters.description: Masternode storage type. Possible options: network-ssd, network-hdd.

parameters.name: datanode_resource_preset
parameters.description: Resources preset (CPU+RAM configuration) for the data nodes of the cluster.

parameters.name: datanode_disk_size
parameters.description: Datanodes storage size in GiB.

parameters.name: datanode_disk_type
parameters.description: Datanodes storage type. Possible options: network-ssd, network-hdd.

parameters.name: computenode_resource_preset
parameters.description: Resources preset (CPU+RAM configuration) for the compute nodes of the cluster.

parameters.name: computenode_disk_size
parameters.description: Computenodes storage size in GiB.

parameters.name: computenode_disk_type
parameters.description: Computenodes storage type. Possible options: network-ssd, network-hdd.

parameters.name: computenode_warmup_duration
parameters.description: The warmup time of the instance in seconds. During this time, traffic is sent to the instance, but instance metrics are not collected. In seconds.

parameters.name: computenode_stabilization_duration
parameters.description: Minimum amount of time in seconds for monitoring before Instance Groups can reduce the number of instances in the group. During this time, the group size doesn't decrease, even if the new metric values indicate that it should. In seconds.

parameters.name: computenode_preemptible
parameters.description: Preemptible instances are stopped at least once every 24 hours, and can be stopped at any time if their resources are needed by Compute.

parameters.name: computenode_cpu_utilization_target
parameters.description: Defines an autoscaling rule based on the average CPU utilization of the instance group. in percents. 10-100. By default is not set and default autoscaling strategy is used.

parameters.name: computenode_decommission_timeout
parameters.description: Timeout to gracefully decommission nodes during downscaling. In seconds

parameters.name: connection_id
parameters.description: ID of the Yandex.Cloud Airflow connection.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Properties passed to main node software. Docs: https://cloud.yandex.com/docs/data-proc/concepts/settings-list

parameters.name: enable_ui_proxy
parameters.description: Enable UI Proxy feature for forwarding Hadoop components web interfaces Docs: https://cloud.yandex.com/docs/data-proc/concepts/ui-proxy

parameters.name: host_group_ids
parameters.description: Dedicated host groups to place VMs of cluster on. Docs: https://cloud.yandex.com/docs/compute/concepts/dedicated-host

parameters.name: security_group_ids
parameters.description: User security groups. Docs: https://cloud.yandex.com/docs/data-proc/concepts/network#security-groups

parameters.name: log_group_id
parameters.description: Id of log group to write logs. By default logs will be sent to default log group. To disable cloud log sending set cluster property dataproc:disable_cloud_logging = true Docs: https://cloud.yandex.com/docs/data-proc/concepts/logs

parameters.name: initialization_actions
parameters.description: Set of init-actions to run when cluster starts. Docs: https://cloud.yandex.com/docs/data-proc/concepts/init-action

parameters.name: oslogin_enabled
parameters.description: Enable authorization via OS Login for cluster.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Cluster labels as key:value pairs. No more than 64 per resource. Docs: https://cloud.yandex.com/docs/resource-manager/concepts/labels

parameters.name: yc_oauth_token
parameters.description: Specifies the user account OAuth token to connect to Yandex Lockbox. The parameter value should look like ``y3_xx123``.

parameters.name: yc_sa_key_json
parameters.description: Specifies the service account key in JSON. The parameter value should look like ``{"id": "...", "service_account_id": "...", "private_key": "..."}``.

parameters.name: yc_sa_key_json_path
parameters.description: Specifies the service account key in JSON file path. The parameter value should look like ``/home/airflow/authorized_key.json``, while the file content should have the following format: ``{"id": "...", "service_account_id": "...", "private_key": "..."}``.

parameters.name: yc_connection_id
parameters.description: Specifies the connection ID to connect to Yandex Lockbox. The default value is ``yandexcloud_default``.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: Specifies the folder ID to search for Yandex Lockbox secrets in. If set to ``None`` (``null`` in JSON), the requests will use the connection ``folder_id``, if specified.

parameters.name: connections_prefix
parameters.description: Specifies the prefix of the secret to read to get connections. If set to ``None`` (``null`` in JSON), the requests for connections will not be sent to Yandex Lockbox. The default value is ``airflow/connections``.

parameters.name: variables_prefix
parameters.description: Specifies the prefix of the secret to read to get variables. If set to ``None`` (``null`` in JSON), the requests for variables will not be sent to Yandex Lockbox. The default value is ``airflow/variables``.

parameters.name: config_prefix
parameters.description: Specifies the prefix of the secret to read to get configurations. If set to ``None`` (``null`` in JSON), the requests for variables will not be sent to Yandex Lockbox. The default value is ``airflow/config``.

parameters.name: sep
parameters.description: Specifies the separator to concatenate ``secret_prefix`` and ``secret_id``. The default value is ``/``.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Specifies the API endpoint. If set to ``None`` (``null`` in JSON), the requests will use the connection endpoint, if specified; otherwise, they will use the default endpoint.
